clockFooter: Real time is the default. Demo time runs the story clock, and the buttons move it forward (from real time, they start the demo clock at today). Countdowns, cooling periods and due dates follow the clock in use.
demoTimeHint: Off: the app uses today's real date and time. On: it uses the demo clock.
intro: Simulated data only. Use these tools to walk through the app quickly.
notifFooter: Sends the text as a bank or wallet notification. Simulated, nothing is charged.
replayHint: Replays the agent's recorded answers instead of asking the live model.
resetConfirm: Reset all simulated data? This cannot be undone.
